title: Whole-counit substitution and scalar normalization for realized operations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L\subset M$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, allowing equality, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_F$, uniformizers $\varpi_F$, and $A_{F,n}=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes have $\ell$ invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On their small pro-etale sites put $R_{F,X}=\lim_n(A_{F,n})_X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $\mathscr S_F(X)$ for the abelian category of strict quotient-module systems with quotient-linear transitions, $\mathcal R_{F,X}$ for derived reduction and $\mathcal L_{F,X}=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ for realization [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. A system $C$ is normalized when $C_m\otimes^L_{A_{F,m}}A_{F,n}\to C_n$ is an isomorphism for $m\geq n$ [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower].

Use the whole-system pullbacks $U_{f,F}$, scalar changes $S_{L/E,X}$ and their specified comparison maps [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], and the completed pullbacks $\widehat U_{f,F}=Lf_F^*$ and scalar extensions $\widehat S_{L/E,X}=T_{L/E,X}$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-integral-scalar-extension].

Supply normalized realization models as defined in [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], with whole-system counit $e:\mathcal R\mathcal L\to1$ induced from the K-injective-normalized constant-tower/limit counit $\epsilon$. Let $C,D\in D(\mathscr S_E(Y))$ be normalized systems whose realizations are in $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and restrict every expression below to systems with constructible-complete intermediate realizations. For a primitive whole-system operation $O$ (a pullback or scalar change), write $\widehat O$ for the corresponding completed operation, and $b_{O,K}:\widehat OK\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal LO\mathcal RK$ for its prescribed model isomorphism. Define
$$r_{O,C}=\mathcal L(O(e_C))\circ b_{O,\mathcal LC}:\widehat O\mathcal LC\longrightarrow\mathcal LOC.$$
These maps are natural isomorphisms on the stated domain. For every whole-system derived morphism $\phi:C\to D$,
$$r_{O,D}\circ\widehat O(\mathcal L\phi)=\mathcal L(O\phi)\circ r_{O,C}.$$
For a finite composable word $w=O_m\cdots O_1$, the iterated $r$ gives a natural isomorphism $r_{w,C}:\widehat w\mathcal LC\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal LwC$. It agrees with substitution of the entire-system counit at every intermediate object, independently of parenthesization; explicitly
$$r_{vw,C}=r_{v,wC}\circ\widehat v(r_{w,C}).$$
For a whole-system comparison $t:w\Rightarrow w'$ built from the specified finite pullback compositor, scalar/pullback comparison, scalar associator and action unitors, its counit-built completed comparison is
$$\widehat t_{\mathcal LC}=r_{w',C}^{-1}\circ\mathcal L(t_C)\circ r_{w,C}.$$
Thus this identification also holds after whiskering by any further completed operation and for composites of these maps; it holds for morphisms of entire derived quotient diagrams, including inverses, rather than merely after finite evaluation.

For coefficient scalar associativity and units, the same identification is compatible with the completion maps $\chi_{L/E,K}:K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat S_{L/E}K$ with quotient/zero-shifted-product normalization [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. In particular, if $\alpha^\otimes:(K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L)\otimes^L_{R_L}R_M\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_M$ is the ordinary derived tensor associator, realization of the system scalar associator is exactly
$$\chi_{M/E,K}\circ\alpha^\otimes_K\circ(\chi_{L/E,K}^{-1}\otimes^L1)\circ\chi_{M/L,\widehat S_{L/E}K}^{-1}.$$
For $E=L$, realization of the system multiplication unit is the multiplication/completeness identification $\widehat S_{E/E}K\cong K$. No faithfulness of separate finite reduction functors and no finite Tor-amplitude assumption is asserted or needed.
